title: Former Bengal deputy speaker Asish Banerjee found hanging at TMC office
content: Former West Bengal deputy speaker Asish Banerjee was found dead on Sunday morning. His body was discovered hanging at a Trinamool Congress office in Rampurhat. Police have sent the body for a post-mortem examination to determine the cause. A purported suicide note was also reportedly recovered from the party office. Banerjee was a five-time MLA from Rampurhat and served as deputy speaker.

title: Cabbie throws passengers out for ‘casteist remarks’, app removes him for 100 years
content: A Lucknow cab driver alleges his account was suspended for 99 years after passengers used casteist slurs. Ankit Kumar asked four passengers to exit his vehicle for their offensive remarks. The incident occurred after the passengers repeatedly targeted a senior officer with casteist comments. Following a viral video, Kumar faced threats and abusive messages on social media. The ride-hailing platform suspended his account without seeking his account of events.

title: Feet moving, mind clear: How Devdutt Padikkal cracked spin puzzle
content: Devdutt Padikkal’s career has been marked by such recoveries. After a modest 119 runs in five matches in the 2023-24 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, he responded with 465 runs at 155 in the Vijay Hazare Trophy and 556 at 92.66 in the Ranji Trophy, including three centuries.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her model allows acquiring debt at low costs and then forgiving it. This approach has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar causes. While philanthropic efforts are scaling, policy reforms for medical debt remain stalled. Scott's work highlights immediate relief possibilities and the need for systemic change.

title: ‘Always proud’: Kim Jong Un hails Russia ties in message to Putin
content: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and Russian President Vladimir Putin have reaffirmed their close relationship.  Their countries are actively cooperating in all sectors, ensuring regional security and stability.  This growing partnership has deepened significantly since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022.  North Korea has provided troops and weapons to support Moscow's war effort.  This exchange highlights competing diplomatic and security dynamics on the Korean peninsula.

title: Zohran Mamdani’s ‘common sense regulation’ may push Amazon to move NYC deliveries
content: Mayor Zohran Mamdani champions a new bill that enforces direct employment for delivery drivers, aiming to eliminate exploitative subcontracting tactics utilized by major corporations. Amazon has cautioned that the implementation of this legislation might compel them to withdraw their delivery services from New York City. Critics argue that this could lead to heightened delivery costs for locals, placing thousands of delivery positions and small enterprises in jeopardy.

title: Meet Jamie Bell, 18, who turned old Lego into a £400,000-a-year business
content: Eighteen-year-old Jamie Bell has remarkably transformed his Lego reselling passion into JTB Collectables, a burgeoning enterprise generating upwards of four hundred thousand dollars annually. Specializing in bulk Lego lots and sought-after minifigures, he appeals to other collectors. As he prepares for university, Jamie aims to grow his business further, securing his financial footing and building savings for the years ahead.

title: In 2024, a Google Maps user found a giant meteorite crater scientists had missed
content: Amateur astronomer Joël Lapointe has unveiled a massive impact crater in Quebec known as the Uhackatik structure, formed by a meteorite 390 million years ago. Geologists have validated this discovery through the identification of shatter cones and melted rock, ensuring the event's authenticity. This find stands as one of the most significant meteorite craters discovered in recent history, with satellite imagery playing a key role in identifying such geological phenomena.

title: 'Voice note, house dispute': How man killed Bengaluru techie before hanging himself
content: A Bengaluru couple was discovered deceased in their rented residence on Thursday morning.  Sumant Jain was found hanging, while his wife Padmavathi was found dead inside.  A WhatsApp voice message from Sumant to his mother became a crucial detail.  The message reportedly followed an argument between the couple over their home.  Police are investigating the exact sequence of events and cause of death for both.

title: 'Toxic' star Yash addresses Rashmika Mandanna's 'Mr Showoff' remark

The actor is now preparing for his upcoming film 'Toxic'.

title: Berkshire Hathaway reshuffles portfolio, raises Alphabet and homebuilder stakes

The company has notably augmented its investments in Alphabet and US homebuilders, while simultaneously diminishing its stakes in various financial firms and other stocks. title: Why Hurricane Lala is a historic threat to Hawaii’s Big Island

title: Giant screens, fans, Carlsen: Chess at EWC gets louder on the esports stage
